name: furnace-york
appliance: York TG9S gas furnace (Johnson Controls installation manual)
grounded_in: Read from the cached PDF 2026-08-19. It is a contractor Installation/UIM document: combustion air, venting, gas piping, start-up adjustments, and an 'Owner Education' checklist reading 'Explain the importance of regular filter replacement and equipment maintenance'. There is no homeowner Care chapter.
notes: The correct answer here is MOSTLY SETUP AND FEW RECURRING TASKS. A parser that manufactures a homeowner calendar out of gas-piping and manometer sections is failing, not being thorough.

must_have.why: The one thing this manual explicitly hands to the owner. Losing it means the product silently drops the single most common furnace task there is.

should_have.why: The owner still has to book it, so it is one of the most valuable reminders the product can give.

must_not_have.why: A one-time commissioning leak test is setup, not a recurring homeowner chore. Emitting it on a cadence tells a homeowner to go poke their gas line every year.
Start-up adjustments performed once by the installer with instruments a homeowner does not own.

forbidden_instructions.why: Explicit prompt rule: never write a hazardous DIY instruction. This manual is full of text that reads like steps and is addressed to a licensed technician.
